postToolUse.bash: engine="$HOME/.impeccable/vaultdex/engine-0.1.5/impeccable"; case "${OSTYPE:-}" in msys*|cygwin*) engine="$engine.exe";; esac; if [ -x "$engine" ]; then "$engine" hook; fi
postToolUse.powershell: $engine = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.impeccable/vaultdex/engine-0.1.5/impeccable.exe'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $engine -PathType Leaf) { & $engine hook; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; exit 0

sessionStart.bash: engine="$HOME/.impeccable/vaultdex/engine-0.1.5/impeccable"; case "${OSTYPE:-}" in msys*|cygwin*) engine="$engine.exe";; esac; if [ ! -x "$engine" ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"additionalContext":"Impeccable fehlt: automatische UI-Pruefung nicht aktiv. Nach Checkout-Pruefung node .vendor/workflow-kit/scripts/install-impeccable-hooks.mjs . ausfuehren; im Kit selbst: node scripts/install-impeccable-hooks.mjs . Danach Hooks freigeben."}'; fi
sessionStart.powershell: $engine = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.impeccable/vaultdex/engine-0.1.5/impeccable.exe'; if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $engine -PathType Leaf)) { Write-Output '{"additionalContext":"Impeccable fehlt: automatische UI-Pruefung nicht aktiv.
